mapper.insert: INSERT INTO checkout_batch(id, batch_no, source_checklist_id, buyer_user_id, batch_status, submit_idempotency_key, rental_start_date, rental_end_date, rental_days, transport_notice_snapshot, rule_snapshot_json, rent_payable_amount_fen, coupon_discount_amount_fen, deposit_original_amount_fen, deposit_waived_amount_fen, deposit_payable_amount_fen, service_fee_fen, freight_prepaid_amount_fen, other_discount_amount_fen, payable_amount_fen, hold_expire_at, submitted_at, created_at, updated_at, request_hash) VALUES (#{batch.id}, #{batch.id}, #{batch.quote.input.checklistId}, #{batch.quote.buyerId}, 'pending_payment', #{batch.requestId}, #{batch.quote.startDate}, #{batch.quote.endDate}, #{batch.quote.rentalDays}, #{batch.transportNotice}, #{batch.ruleSnapshotJson}, #{batch.quote.amounts.rentOriginalFen}, #{batch.quote.amounts.couponDiscountFen}, #{batch.quote.amounts.depositFen}, 0, #{batch.quote.amounts.depositFen}, 0, #{batch.quote.amounts.freightFen}, 0, #{batch.quote.amounts.totalFen}, #{batch.expiry}, #{batch.at}, #{batch.at}, #{batch.at}, #{batch.requestHash})

INSERT INTO checkout_batch_transport_snapshot(id, checkout_batch_id, factory_id, outbound_service_mode, return_service_mode, factory_address_snapshot, receiver_address_snapshot, outbound_vehicle_tier_id, return_vehicle_tier_id, outbound_distance_meter, return_distance_meter, outbound_guide_min_amount_fen, outbound_guide_max_amount_fen, return_guide_min_amount_fen, return_guide_max_amount_fen, outbound_prepaid_amount_fen, return_prepaid_amount_fen, freight_prepaid_amount_fen, route_pricing_snapshot_json, transport_requirement_snapshot, buyer_remark_snapshot, created_at) VALUES (#{transport.id}, #{transport.batchId}, #{transport.factory.factoryId}, #{transport.factory.outbound.serviceMode}, #{transport.factory.returnLeg.serviceMode}, #{transport.factory.address}, #{transport.receiverAddress}, #{transport.factory.outbound.vehicle.id}, #{transport.factory.returnLeg.vehicle.id}, #{transport.factory.outbound.route.distanceMeter}, #{transport.factory.returnLeg.route.distanceMeter}, #{transport.factory.outbound.guideMinFen}, #{transport.factory.outbound.guideMaxFen}, #{transport.factory.returnLeg.guideMinFen}, #{transport.factory.returnLeg.guideMaxFen}, #{transport.factory.outbound.prepaidFen}, #{transport.factory.returnLeg.prepaidFen}, #{transport.factory.amounts.freightFen}, #{transport.routeSnapshotJson}, #{transport.transportRequirements}, #{transport.factory.buyerRemark}, #{transport.at})

INSERT INTO checkout_batch_item_snapshot(id, checkout_batch_id, source_checklist_item_id, source_checklist_id, factory_id, factory_name_snapshot, sku_id, prop_name_snapshot, image_url_snapshot, asset_type_snapshot, type_label_snapshot, style_labels_snapshot, quantity, rental_start_date, rental_end_date, rental_days, daily_rent_price_fen, rent_amount_fen, coupon_discount_amount_fen, rent_cash_payable_amount_fen, deposit_unit_amount_fen, deposit_original_amount_fen, deposit_waived_amount_fen, deposit_payable_amount_fen, checkout_batch_transport_snapshot_id, transport_requirement_snapshot, item_snapshot_json, created_at) VALUES (#{item.item.snapshotItemId}, #{item.batchId}, #{item.item.sourceItemId}, #{item.checklistId}, #{item.factory.factoryId}, #{item.factory.factoryName}, #{item.item.snapshot.skuId}, #{item.item.snapshot.name}, #{item.imageKey}, #{item.item.snapshot.assetType}, #{item.item.snapshot.typeLabel}, #{item.styleLabels}, #{item.item.quantity}, #{item.quote.startDate}, #{item.quote.endDate}, #{item.quote.rentalDays}, #{item.item.snapshot.prices.dailyRentPriceFen}, #{item.item.rentOriginalFen}, #{item.item.couponDiscountFen}, #{item.item.rentCashFen}, #{item.item.snapshot.prices.depositAmountFen}, #{item.item.depositFen}, 0, #{item.item.depositFen}, #{item.transportId}, #{item.item.transportRequirement}, #{item.itemSnapshotJson}, #{item.at})
mapper.select: SELECT factory_id FROM checkout_batch_transport_snapshot WHERE checkout_batch_id=#{id} ORDER BY factory_id
mapper.update: UPDATE checkout_batch SET batch_status='payment_exception', recovery_mode=CASE WHEN recovery_mode='refund_batch' OR #{mode}='refund_batch' THEN 'refund_batch' ELSE #{mode} END, exception_reason=#{reason}, version=version+1, updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND batch_status!='paid' AND batch_status!='refunded_closed'

UPDATE checkout_batch SET batch_status='paid', paid_at=#{paidAt}, guard_released_at=COALESCE(guard_released_at, #{now}), exception_resolved_at=#{now}, exception_reason=NULL, version=version+1, updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND guard_released_at IS NULL AND (recovery_mode IS NULL OR recovery_mode='recover_orders')

UPDATE rental_checklist SET checklist_status='converted_to_order', active_slot_no=NULL, current_checkout_batch_id=NULL, converted_order_at=#{now}, version=version+1, updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND current_checkout_batch_id=#{batch} AND checklist_status='checkout_processing'

UPDATE checkout_batch SET batch_status=#{status}, guard_released_at=COALESCE(guard_released_at, #{now}), closed_at=COALESCE(closed_at, #{now}), expired_at=CASE WHEN #{status}='expired' THEN COALESCE(expired_at, #{now}) ELSE expired_at END, exception_resolved_at=#{now}, version=version+1, updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id}

UPDATE checkout_batch SET batch_status='refund_processing', recovery_mode='refund_batch', version=version+1, updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND recovery_mode='refund_batch' AND batch_status NOT IN ('paid', 'refunded_closed')
